name: NEXUS AI Gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible AI gateway with a dashboard, audit logs and spend control.

ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_USERNAME.description: Username for the first dashboard admin account.

ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD.description: Password for that account. Use a long, unique password.

AIGATEWAY_MASTER_KEY.description: Optional. A bearer key for API calls before you create API keys in the dashboard.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. You can also add provider keys later in the dashboard.
